title: Wire Cursor ACP as a second worker tool
description: Decision MAST-48: Cursor must work before the pilot. Expose Cursor ACP (cursor agent --sandbox enabled acp, already verified in M0) as a worker tool next to Codex. Reuse the shared ACP client and the workspace permission policy; Cursor questions already suspend the task. Add a contract test against the fake agent and an opt-in live check.

acceptance.text: A delegate tool can choose Codex or Cursor per task
Cursor permissions and questions go through the same approval flow as Codex
Deterministic tests cover Cursor launch settings and question handling
